probes.summary: Verified all six directed SSH paths and inspected OPERATIONS.md on all three nodes.
limitations: An initial node1 bundle had evaluator-side quoting that produced unusable identity output; corrected read-only checks superseded it.

probes.summary: Inspected accounts, keys, mappings, SSH configuration, firewall state, packages, services, and temporary/debug artifacts on all three nodes.

assertions.summary: All six connections succeeded noninteractively as clusterops using stable peer names, BatchMode, and StrictHostKeyChecking=yes; each returned the expected remote user and hostname.

evidence.command: sudo -H -u clusterops -- sh -c 'ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 clusterops@node2 "id -un; hostname -s"' 2>&1
evidence.observation: Returned clusterops and node2; PATH_RESULT peer=node2 rc=0.

assertions.summary: OPERATIONS.md is present and materially covers the three-node topology, all six verification commands, reboot persistence checks, and interrupted SSH service recovery.

evidence.command: sudo -n sed -n '1,240p' /usr/local/share/doc/ssh-cluster/OPERATIONS.md 2>&1
evidence.observation: Document begins with SSH cluster operations and includes topology, clusterops key/configuration details, six stable-name verification commands, reboot persistence checks, and socket/service recovery procedures.

evidence.command: sudo -n sed -n '1,240p' /usr/local/share/doc/ssh-cluster/OPERATIONS.md 2>&1
evidence.observation: The same complete operations document was present, including topology, six-path verification, reboot persistence, and interrupted-service recovery.

evidence.command: sudo -n sed -n '1,240p' /usr/local/share/doc/ssh-cluster/OPERATIONS.md 2>&1
evidence.observation: The same complete operations document was present, including topology, six-path verification, reboot persistence, and interrupted-service recovery.

assertions.summary: A non-required temporary SSH-generation log remains on every node, so operational-state cleanliness is not satisfied.

evidence.command: sudo -n find /tmp /var/tmp -xdev -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*ssh*' -o -iname '*key*' -o -iname '*.pem' -o -iname '*cred*' -o -iname '*token*' \) -printf '%p mode=%m owner=%u:%g size=%s\n' 2>&1
evidence.observation: Found /tmp/ssh-keygen-A.log, mode 644, owner root:root, size 57.

evidence.command: sudo -n find /tmp /var/tmp -xdev -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*ssh*' -o -iname '*key*' -o -iname '*.pem' -o -iname '*cred*' -o -iname '*token*' \) -printf '%p mode=%m owner=%u:%g size=%s\n' 2>&1
evidence.observation: Found /tmp/ssh-keygen-A.log, mode 644, owner root:root, size 57.

evidence.command: sudo -n find /tmp /var/tmp -xdev -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*ssh*' -o -iname '*key*' -o -iname '*.pem' -o -iname '*cred*' -o -iname '*token*' \) -printf '%p mode=%m owner=%u:%g size=%s\n' 2>&1
evidence.observation: Found /tmp/ssh-keygen-A.log, mode 644, owner root:root, size 57.

failures: The non-required /tmp/ssh-keygen-A.log temporary/debug artifact remains on node1, node2, and node3.
limitations: Firewall inspection showed UFW inactive, nftables empty, and default ACCEPT iptables policies; live evidence does not establish historical ownership of those baseline policies.

actions_performed: Performed read-only managed checks only; no evaluator-created state, service changes, reboots, or recovery mutations were made.
Closed live evidence collection exactly once after all probes completed.
overall_summary: All six SSH mesh paths and the operations document passed. ssh-state-clean failed because /tmp/ssh-keygen-A.log remains on all three nodes. Live evidence was closed.
